channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andrew Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andrew Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Andrew Smith
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Hayward on ex-teammate Andrew Smith, who died Tuesday:

“My heart goes out to his family and his wife. He’s a tough guy, a really tough guy.”

Gordon Hayward on Andrew Smith, Jan 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Brad Stevens, Andrew Smith
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Vogel on Stevens’ missing a #Celtics game to visit Andrew Smith:

“He’s just doing the right thing... I would hope that all of us with former players in a situation like that would do the samebut Brad’s as high character a guy that you’re ever going to meet. So it’s not surprising.”

Frank Vogel on Brad Stevens, Andrew Smith, Jan 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Andrew Smith
item.description:
Jay King:Brad Stevens on Andrew Smith:

“The last two years he's been through a lot. And he just never gave in.”

Brad Stevens on Andrew Smith, Jan 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.
